follow-up time: Within the first 24 hours after birth
outcome: Taxonomic composition of the meconium microbiome
Metabolic functions of the meconium microbiome
cohort: Chinese infants delivered vaginally or via cesarean section, including IVF newborns
finding: Infants delivered vaginally have a more diverse meconium microbiome with a higher abundance of Propionibacterium species, while C-section-delivered infants show lower diversity and a higher prevalence of Bacillus licheniformis.
mod_finding: The meconium microbiome of IVF newborns delivered by C-section exhibits similarities to the vaginal microbiome in terms of taxonomic composition.
